# Reuse the existing copy-message interface at protocol notification boundaries

1172 removes the custom stream-listener IDL but retains nsICopyMessageListener. Accepted IMAP StartMessage and EndMessage query the stored copy state to that interface rather than to the concrete helper. The concrete class implements both stream and copy interfaces. This narrows component registration while preserving protocol callbacks. It does not mean every internal helper can shed an interface, or that a concrete rename removes all QueryInterface use. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mailnews/base/public.
